switch.question: Can I switch plans later?
switch.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When you upgrade, you will be charged the prorated difference. When you downgrade, your new rate will apply at the next billing cycle.

data.question: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
data.answer: Your data is never deleted. If you exceed the limits of your new plan (e.g., multiple circles on Free), you will still have read access but cannot add new content until you upgrade or reduce usage.

trial.question: Is there a free trial for Plus?
trial.answer: Yes! Plus comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start. You will get full access to all Plus features during the trial period.

teamsBilling.question: How does billing work for Care Teams?
teamsBilling.answer: Care Teams is billed annually based on the number of care circles and users. Contact our sales team for a custom quote tailored to your organization's needs.

hipaa.question: Is Kintwadi HIPAA compliant?
hipaa.answer: Kintwadi implements industry-standard security measures including encryption at rest and in transit. For organizations requiring a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA), this is available on the Care Teams plan.

freeMembers.question: Can I add family members for free?
freeMembers.answer: Yes! All plans allow you to invite family members and caregivers to your care circles at no additional cost. The plan limits apply to the number of circles and features, not the number of people.

hero.tagline: One shared record for everyone caring for someone.
hero.subtitle: Kintwadi is the calm, role-aware home for a family's caregiving — across siblings, cities, and time zones. One source of truth for today's meds, the care timeline, appointments, tasks and vitals.

problem.title: Caregiving is universal — and badly tooled
problem.subtitle: When a parent starts needing help, coordination falls to chaotic group chats, sticky notes, and one exhausted “default” child.

sandwich.title: The sandwich generation is drowning
sandwich.body: Adults care for aging parents while raising kids and working. The labor is invisible, unpaid, and emotionally heavy.

coordination.title: Coordination is a mess
coordination.body: Care runs on WhatsApp threads, paper med lists, and memory. There's no single source of truth, so things fall through the cracks.

details.title: Dropped details are dangerous
details.body: Medication errors are among the most common, preventable causes of harm for older adults. “Did Mom take her pills?” shouldn't be a guess.

global.title: Families are global now
global.body: The person who loves the patient most is often thousands of kilometres away — and feels powerless and guilty.

difference.title: The underserved middle
difference.subtitle: Clinical software is built for institutions; family organizers have no concept of care. Kintwadi is the family-grade, role-aware care record — built on three ideas no one has combined well.

fairShare.title: Fair-share visibility
fairShare.body: Everyone can see who contributed what. Making the invisible labor visible defuses the #1 cause of family caregiving conflict.

diaspora.title: The diaspora digest
diaspora.body: An AI-written, warm daily update that keeps the faraway relative emotionally connected — turning guilt into participation.

oneRecord.title: One record, many lenses
oneRecord.body: The aide, the remote sibling, the coordinator and the parent each see a view scoped to their role — enforced at the database, not just the UI.

personas.title: One record, a view for everyone
personas.subtitle: The same source of truth — scoped to each person's role, enforced at the database, not just the UI.

coordinator.name: The Coordinator
coordinator.need: One place to run everything, and to stop being the single point of failure.

remoteSibling.name: The Remote Sibling
remoteSibling.need: To know Mom is okay today, and an easy way to help from another time zone.

careRecipient.name: The Care Recipient
careRecipient.need: A respectful, simplified view — and control over who sees what.

professional.name: The Professional Caregiver
professional.need: Clear daily meds & tasks, fast logging, scoped access — never family financials.

extended.name: The Extended Circle
extended.need: Read-only reassurance and a way to help when asked.

agency.name: Care Manager / Agency
agency.need: A multi-family dashboard with continuity, accountability and audit.

pillars.title: Everything a family's care needs
pillars.subtitle: A deep, calm product — not a generic dashboard with 40 widgets.

record.title: Shared care record
record.body: A rich profile, a secure document vault, and an always-current emergency card.

medication.title: Medication management
medication.body: Schedules, give/skip logging, refill alerts, and interaction & allergy warnings.

timeline.title: Care timeline
timeline.body: One chronological feed of meds, meals, mood, vitals, visits, notes and photos.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.body: Shared calendar, who's taking them, pre-visit prep and post-visit summaries.

tasks.title: Tasks & rota
tasks.body: Assignable recurring tasks, a shift schedule, and the gentle fair-share report.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.body: Distinct roles, granular scoping, a clean invite flow, and an immutable audit log.

vitals.title: Vitals & health
vitals.body: Blood pressure, glucose, weight, sleep and mood — with trends and threshold alerts.

smart.title: The smart layer
smart.body: Daily Digest, decline detection, and Ask Kintwadi in plain language.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Role- and event-aware alerts, urgent escalation, and in-context comments.

emergency.title: Emergency mode
emergency.body: One tap surfaces a shareable emergency card, ready for EMS or an ER, in any language.

principles.title: Made for this audience
principles.subtitle: Warm, accessible, mobile-first — visibly built for stressed caregivers and older adults.

calm.title: Calm over busy
calm.body: Stressed caregivers need reassurance, not 40 widgets — one glanceable answer: “Is she okay today?”

warm.title: Warm, not clinical
warm.body: A tender domain handled with a human, dignified tone — respectful, never infantilizing.

accessible.title: Accessible by default
accessible.body: Large type, high contrast, simple flows, screen-reader friendly. Accessibility is the UX.

mobile.title: Mobile-first
mobile.body: Caregiving happens on a phone, on the move — so the experience is built for it.

lenses.title: One record, many lenses
lenses.body: Each role gets a purpose-built view, so it feels effortless from the aide to the patient.

transparency.title: Trust through transparency
transparency.body: An append-only audit log and DB-enforced access build medical-grade, family-grade trust.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Kintwadi collects, uses, and protects the information you trust us with.

short.title: The short version
short.body: Kintwadi holds sensitive information about families and the people they care for. We collect only what we need to coordinate care, we never sell your data, and we scope every person's access to their role.

collect.title: What we collect
items: Account details — your name, email, and avatar.
Care-circle content you add — the care recipient's profile, medications, timeline updates, tasks, appointments, vitals, and documents.
Usage and device information needed to keep the service secure and reliable.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To provide the service: showing each member the right slice of one shared record, sending notifications and the Daily Digest, and surfacing safety signals like missed-med streaks or interaction warnings.
use.body2: We do not sell personal information or use care content for advertising.

who.title: Who can see your data
who.body: Access is determined by role within a care circle and enforced at the database with row-level security — a hired aide, for example, can never read a family's financial or legal documents. Every sensitive action is recorded in an append-only audit log.

choices.title: Your choices
items: Export a copy of your circle's record at any time.
Control what you share — the care recipient decides what others see about them.
Delete your account; we remove your personal data on request.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The agreement between you and Kintwadi when you use the service.

using.title: Using Kintwadi
using.body: Kintwadi helps families and care teams coordinate care. By creating an account you agree to use it lawfully, to keep your login secure, and to respect the privacy of everyone in your care circles.

notMedical.title: Not a medical service
notMedical.body: Kintwadi is a coordination tool, not a medical device or a provider of medical advice. Safety features such as interaction warnings and decline detection are supportive aids — they don't replace professional clinical judgment. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You keep ownership of the content you add. You grant us the limited permission needed to store and display it to the right members and to operate features like the Daily Digest. You're responsible for having the right to share information about the people you care for.

billing.title: Plans & billing
billing.body: Free and paid plans are described on our pricing page. Paid subscriptions renew until cancelled; you can change or cancel at any time, with changes taking effect at the next billing cycle.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
items: Don't misuse the service, attempt to break its security, or access data you're not entitled to.
Don't upload unlawful content or impersonate others.
Respect the role-based permissions of your care circle.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms as the product evolves. We'll note the date above and, for material changes, let you know in the app or by email.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Kintwadi holds sensitive health and family data. Protecting it is a first-class design goal, not an afterthought.

depth.title: Defense in depth
depth.body: Caregiving is an inherently access-controlled domain, so we built security into the data model itself. Permissions are enforced at multiple layers — the edge, the application, and the database — so a single bug can't expose data a person shouldn't see.

encryption.title: Encryption everywhere
encryption.body: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest.

rls.title: Row-level security
rls.body: Role-based access is enforced in the database, not just the UI.

audit.title: Append-only audit log
audit.body: Every sensitive read or change is recorded and immutable.

leastPriv.title: Least privilege
leastPriv.body: Each role sees only the slice of the record it needs.

resilient.title: Resilient data
resilient.body: Managed Postgres with automated, encrypted backups.

secrets.title: Secrets stay server-side
secrets.body: Credentials live in environment config — never in the client.

db.title: Enforced at the database
db.body: Row-level security means a hired aide physically cannot read a family's financial documents, and safety-critical actions like “give a medication” commit as a single atomic transaction — logging the event, decrementing supply, and writing the timeline entry together, or not at all.

disclosure.title: Responsible disclosure
disclosure.body: Found a vulnerability? We appreciate your help. Email security@kintwadi.app and we'll respond promptly.

hipaa.title: HIPAA
hipaa.subtitle: Kintwadi is built with HIPAA principles in mind — designed to protect health information from day one.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.body: Kintwadi handles Protected Health Information (PHI), so we follow HIPAA's security and privacy principles throughout the product: minimum-necessary access, strong technical safeguards, and a full audit trail. This page describes our design posture; it is not a claim of formal certification.

safeguards: Encryption of PHI in transit and at rest
Role-based access enforced at the database (row-level security)
An append-only audit log of who viewed or changed what
Clear separation of demo data from any real data

baa.title: Business Associate Agreements (BAA)
baa.body: For organizations that require a signed BAA — home-care agencies, assisted-living facilities, and similar — a BAA is available on our Care Teams plan. Reach out to sales@kintwadi.app to start the conversation.

report.title: Reporting a concern
report.body: If you believe health information may have been handled improperly, contact privacy@kintwadi.app and we'll investigate.
